definitions.explanation: Transportation service that picks up and drops off people, commonly offered by hotels, airports, and various facilities.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}から{送迎|そうげい}バスが{出|で}ている。
examples.english: There's a shuttle bus from the station.

examples.japanese: ホテルの{送迎|そうげい}サービスを{利用|りよう}した。
examples.english: I used the hotel's shuttle service.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}{送迎|そうげい}は{無料|むりょう}ですか。

notes:
FORMATION:
{送|そう} (sending) + {迎|げい} (welcoming/receiving)

VERB FORM:
{送迎|そうげい}する - to provide pickup and drop-off

COLLOCATIONS:
・{送迎|そうげい}バス - shuttle bus
・{送迎|そうげい}サービス - shuttle service
・{送迎|そうげい}{付|つ}き - with shuttle service
・{空港|くうこう}{送迎|そうげい} - airport transfer
・{無料|むりょう}{送迎|そうげい} - free shuttle service

CONTEXTS:
・ホテル - hotels
・{旅館|りょかん} - Japanese inns
・{結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう} - wedding venues
・{幼稚園|ようちえん} - kindergartens
・{介護|かいご}{施設|しせつ} - nursing care facilities
